newsitem.title: USA: NY regulators to review IPP purchase curtailments.
newsitem.headline: NY regulators to review IPP purchase curtailments.

text.p: The New York Public Service Commission said Tuesday it will review requests for reimbursement if a utility curtails purchases of electricity from an independent power producer.

"Curtailment" is permitted by a Federal Energy Regulatory Commission rule if purchases from the power producer will result in costs greater than those the utility would pay to generate the power itself, the regulators said in a statement.
Responding to a Niagara Mohawk Power Corp petition, the New York Commission established procedures for curtailment unless curtailment is prohibited by contract.

Post-curtailment review, as opposed to pre-curtailment review, eliminates the need to invest significant time and resources trying to definitvely pre-establish the terms of each curtailment, the commission said.
